study: daily rolling delta-hedged short-volatility synthetic book
limitations: daily entries and marks are synthetic_model because dense historical option books are not present locally
DVOL is a 30-day volatility index, not the executable bid IV of a 14-day straddle
spot is used as a forward proxy and funding is a fixed historical mean
margin is a standard-formula approximation; a breach is reported, not a venue liquidation simulation
this experiment is separate from and cannot alter the sealed live holdout specification
